categories.cta: See all types of SMP treatments – scalp micropigmentation:

answers.question: How long does SMP treatment – scalp micropigmentation take?
answers.text: SMP treatment (scalp micropigmentation) is performed in 2 to 4 sessions, spaced 7–14 days apart. Each SMP session lasts approximately 2–3 hours.

answers.question: Does SMP treatment (scalp micropigmentation) hurt?
answers.text: SMP treatment is slightly uncomfortable, but most clients describe it as a scratching sensation. Scalp micropigmentation does not require local anesthesia, except in special cases (upon client request).

answers.question: How long does the effect of SMP treatment (scalp micropigmentation) last?
answers.text: The effect of scalp micropigmentation (SMP treatment) lasts 2 to 4 years, after which a refresh session is recommended.

answers.question: Is scalp micropigmentation (SMP) the same as a tattoo?
answers.text: No. SMP treatment uses special hair tattoo pigments, fine needles, and shallow punctures. SMP does not blur or change color like regular tattoos.

categories.title: SMP FOR BALDNESS – SCALP MICROPIGMENTATION LJUBLJANA
categories.cta: More about SMP treatment for baldness:

answers.question: What does scalp micropigmentation (SMP) look like on bald men?
answers.text: SMP treatment creates the effect of a closely shaved head. Scalp micropigmentation imitates hair follicles and follows the natural shape of the head – hair tattoo.

answers.question: Is there a visible difference between SMP pigment and real hair?
answers.text: If SMP treatment (scalp micropigmentation) is professionally performed – no. The tone of the SMP pigment is chosen according to hair and skin color.

categories.title: SMP FOR THINNING HAIR – SCALP MICROPIGMENTATION

answers.question: Do I need to shave my head for SMP treatment if hair is thin?
answers.text: No. For scalp micropigmentation for thinning hair, natural length is maintained, and SMP pigment is used to fill light gaps.

answers.question: Can I combine SMP treatment (scalp micropigmentation) with hair transplant?
answers.text: Yes. SMP treatment is often done after a hair transplant to increase density with scalp micropigmentation and fill gaps.

answers.question: Can SMP pigment (scalp micropigmentation) be applied to a scar?
answers.text: Yes – SMP treatment effectively covers scars after transplant (FUE/FUT), as well as scars from injuries. Scalp micropigmentation is ideal for scars.

answers.question: Is SMP treatment (scalp micropigmentation) safe on scar tissue?
answers.text: Yes, SMP treatment is performed carefully and in layers – scalp micropigmentation after skin analysis.

tretmanFlow.title: HOW SMP TREATMENT WORKS – SCALP MICROPIGMENTATION
tretmanFlow.description: Note: Throughout the SMP process (scalp micropigmentation), a fine needle and special hair tattoo pigment designed for the scalp are used. The client can resume daily activities the day after SMP treatment.

text.normal: – Analysis of scalp micropigmentation available live in Ljubljana studio or via Viber/WhatsApp video call
– The frontal hairline and shape of the micropigmentation are determined, then the base layer of SMP pigment is applied

– Usually performed 10–20 days after the first session. The goal is to stabilize the SMP pigment. During this session, density is increased and transitions are refined – hair tattoo becomes more natural.
– Final SMP treatment, where the frontal line and any imperfections are corrected. If additional adjustment is needed, an extra session is provided at no extra cost.
After 2–4 years, a refresh session is possible to maintain scalp micropigmentation.
